title.en: Two refined cloud icons to choose from
title.zh: 两个打磨过的云图标，请你选一个

summary.en: Your answers from issues #1 to #4 are processed: R-001 and R-002 are accepted, A-002 is approved (several equal admins, rejected members may re-register with no cooldown) and A-001 is denied. The no-cooldown change (R-060) is done and all 131 backend tests pass. A new request, A-003, asks you to choose between two refinements of the report site's own cloud icon. See the Decisions page.
summary.zh: 你在议题 #1 到 #4 里的回答已处理：R-001 和 R-002 已验收，A-002 已批准（允许多位地位相同的管理员，被拒绝的成员可无限制重新注册，没有冷却期），A-001 已拒绝。取消冷却期的改动（R-060）已完成，后端 131 项测试全部通过。新的请求 A-003 请你在报告网站自己的云图标的两个打磨方案中选一个，见“决策”页。

bullets.en: **Variant A, Sky:** your blue tile and white cloud with a system-icon finish (continuous corners, soft depth). The designer recommends it.
bullets.zh: **方案 A，Sky：**你的蓝底白云，按系统图标的质感完成（连续曲率圆角、柔和的层次）。设计师推荐。

bullets.en: **Variant B, Porcelain:** a pale tile (graphite in dark mode) with a blue cloud. Quieter, less recognisable.
bullets.zh: **方案 B，Porcelain：**浅色底（深色模式为石墨色）配蓝云。更安静，但辨识度较低。

bullets.en: On the Decisions page, **Approve** picks A and **Deny** picks B. The page shows both in light and dark, at 16, 32, 64 and 180 pixels, as an app icon and next to today's logo.
bullets.zh: 在“决策”页，点**批准**选 A，点**拒绝**选 B。页面按浅色与深色、16、32、64、180 像素、应用图标，以及与现在的标志对比来展示两者。

text.zh: 页面能构建，所有链接都有效，但本次会话没有浏览器，所以图标和页面还没有在屏幕上看过，也没有截图。回答之前，请先在手机上看一眼这个页面。
